summary: GeoVax Labs filed an 8-K on September 10, 2026, disclosing a Nasdaq listing update via press release. The company is appealing an August 27, 2026 delisting determination tied to the minimum bid price requirement under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(2); a Nasdaq Hearings Panel hearing is set for October 13, 2026. The hearing request stays suspension or delisting pending the hearing and any extension granted. GeoVax intends to present a compliance plan and reaffirmed focus on GEO-MVA Phase 3, manufacturing, and strategic partnerships. Watch for Panel ruling, potential reverse split, or financing-driven dilution risk.
